title.narrative: Training Academy for Heavy Duty Industry Equipment and Commercial Vehicles (HDIECV)

description.narrative: This project aims to contribute to this objective by establishing a training academy, in partnership with Volvo, the United States Agency for International Development (USAID), the Office Chérifien des Phosphates (OCP) Foundation and the United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO), offering courses in maintenance of heavy duty industrial equipment and commercial vehicles, thereby providing a yearly intake of 150 students with the skills needed to find employment in the (HDIECV). The training academy will be located within an existing vocational training center (VTC) in Morocco, Ecole des Métiers du Bâtiment et Travaux Publics, which is run by the Office of Vocational Training and Employment Promotion (OFPPT), at Settat (Morocco). The center will not only target students from Morocco, but also from Côte d#Ivoire and Senegal, in order to foster regional cooperation in skills development within North and West Africa.
